Best app for keeping organised.

I bought the lifetime version, absolutely love this app. AI function is great and makes creating tasks so easy.

title.label: THE BEST PLANNING APP I’VE EVER DOWNLOADED!

content.label: Structured is more than 5 stars. It has so many features even without any extra purchases. It helps me keep my mornings and evenings so planned and organised which helps have a better routine. Sometimes in the morning I try and do things earlier than the time on structured as a fun challenge to see how quick I can get ready. I absolutely recommend structured to anyone and everyone!
Adore this app!!! As a student, time-management is probably the biggest challenge i face, and I haven’t found an app with such a smooth interface before (perfect for us OCD folks)!!
you literally have to pay to make daily reminders don’t download this crao
Get it. I love how you can drag and drop the tasks to move them around. It’s so useful.

In college, things become too complex, making it difficult for me to remember the timing of each event and some important details. As a result, I had to download and try many to-do list apps from the App Store one by one. However, after careful consideration, only Structured has satisfied me. Structured not only provides a clear vertical timeline for displaying tasks but also tracks and measures my daily energy, making my capability limits clear. This helps me avoid setting daily goals that are too high, which could damage my limited self-confidence and self-discipline. Additionally, one of my favorite features is its ability to integrate with calendars and reminders. Whenever changes occur in the other two apps, Structured quickly synchronizes, which is very convenient for managing multiple long-term plans. Last but not least, Structured offers a one-year scholarship and even full scholarships for students with financial constraints, which is truly amazing! I am very grateful to Structured for providing such a great opportunity to become more efficient and confident.
I've dropped a star as it would be good to be able to reorder sub-tasks. Is there a way this can be built into the app?
For someone like myself who loves structure and knowing what they’re doing during the day this is brilliant

i think this app is really cute and helps me stay on track with revision for school too however i do think there could be a little more to it , such as more fitness related stuff and homework things. I also think there should be more options on icons because i do swimming a lot but that icon is locked so i guess id just find it easier if i had a swimming icon but over all a really cute app, defo recommend 💞

I read the reviews under this app, and everyone was raving about it so i thought i would try it out. Very limited features for free users and hard to use. I must be missing out on something, or they are buying reviews for this, because it was honestly - mediocre at best.

Finally I have found an app that has the perfect mix of structure, simplicity and aesthetic.

A reasonably straightforward timeline, good reminder options and an additional to-do list for when you need to remember tasks that have no specific time, so you can fit them in when you have space in your day. Did I mention that the timeline also clearly tells you the amount of free time between tasks? It’s really good!  Also the widget keeps a running timeline in real time, so you can see how long your current task has left, and what is coming up next?

All in all a good app for those of us who work well with a clear list and reminders, but want something that isn’t too overwhelming to set up. I have ADHD and the difference this app has made is astounding.  I did the free trial and then happily slid into the paid subscription, which is incredibly reasonably priced.

Thanks Structured, you are amazing!

title.label: I am happy for the planner

content.label: I’ve been in a flop era again with planning and routines and come back to this app and it’s so good for adhd / autism. I thrive on routine but can get overwhelmed and this app is perfect it’s user friendly and colours work well with my dyslexia

It’s awesome that I can take a photo of a list with set times/ duration next to each task and the AI will do the rest, also the task creation is impressive.. I wish there was a way to reschedule all tasks easier - the AI can do it but you have to delete all the previous tasks 1 by 1. Would be good if there was a reschedule feature like Sorted3.

Love this app, worth paying extra for the premium as you get to customise with all different symbols and colours. You can make your own colours which is amazing for those who love pastels like me. Still waiting hopefully for updates as I wish there was a search bar as it is annoying not knowing where something is unless I look. Love how you can choose a colour for the format. I also hope they add routines to the app as would love to have that. Love the way you can easily change different tasks to different days and times including repeats (on premium). Had a few issues where the app doesn’t register when I have changed something which can be annoying but these things happen. Love how when adding a new task you can add a previous task you’ve done before which would usually take time but they don’t always show up for a certain previous one which is strange. This has helped me so much in completing my tasks and also seeing how long each takes, you can choose from different formats which suit you best, I have chosen the most simplest as I don’t like too much information regarding my different tasks
After three months of working perfectly one day 99% of info was simply missing. Nowhere to be found and not on back up.
Couldn’t survive without this!! It’s the best app for my adhd

I have had this app for many years now it is absolutely amazing. I have linked it up with my calendar and my reminders to help me manage my days much better.
I am a student as well as a parent and trying to remember everything is very difficult as well as trying to plan.
I love that I can colour code everything too

I have never written a review for an app before but I am so impressed with Structured that here I am! Honestly this app is amazing. I have been looking for an app to do exactly what Structured does for me for years (since I have ADHD it makes organisation, routines and remembering tasks very difficult) and I have never come across anything which works so well for me. Other apps are far more expensive and have never fully done what I need them to. I LOVE this app and the Apple Watch integration is amazing. I only need to glance at my watch and I know what’s coming next. The sub steps also mean I never forget anything. 

The integration with calender and reminders makes life so easy - with everything in one place rather than across multiple apps. 

Also being dyslexic I really appreciate the simplified view and the open dyslexie font. I wish this came as standard for all apps! 

Definitely download this app!

I have been using this app for a couple of years now, I started with the free trial and then paid for the yearly subscription.
Little did I know what a game changer it would be. Having struggled with time blindness and various other issues related to undiagnosed adhd and asd, the new planner allows me to set my day out in a user friendly and colourful way.
The recent addition of the energy tracking (spoons) has made it even more worthwhile, you can choose how much energy to start the day with or just leave it on the default setting.
Many thanks for a wonderful app, and long may it continue.
Useful

The app is good, and the AI integration is extremely helpful. I just don't understand why there isn't an option to batch delete items... Deleting items one by one is annoying and extremely counterproductive, which contradicts the app's goal of enhancing productivity.
Click away, always accessible, never forget anything but also no pressure. I get more done knowing all my tasks are in one place. So fun to use & choose colours too!!

title.label: Been using it daily for years. Just what I need.

content.label: The new AI feature where I can either speak or write out a short paragraph and it will correctly schedule my entire day has made it go from 10/10 to 11/10. Brilliant scheduling app especailly if your on the choatic ADHD/ADD side of  the fence like I am.

I love this app and for the first time I can just think about what I need to do tomorrow and an app plans and writes down everything for me in a perfect way. Addition of ways to actually start and end tasks and other tasks automatically shifting can be really good. To be honest there are just so many potential features that can come in the future, I am excited to see how it goes. Note: would love the have a key shortcut option for the mac app to quickly add tasks!

Note2: the ability to talk to the ai assistant and say this task will last half an hour extra, move my upcoming tasks accordingly would be appreciated. Also ability to choose multiple tasks to delete instead of individually would be great. Also me and my partner would love to have shared tasks that we both can see in out daily schedule.

It’s free and the best :D
If u don’t have it then WHAT ARE YOU DOING WITH YOUR LIFE?!
get it now!

title.label: Very rarely leave reviews but this app is everything

content.label: I have been looking and looking for an app to help me with my schedule and this app is amazing! It is literally everything I want and so easy to use!

i never usually review anything! especially apps. but oh my goodness.

i’m a university student with pretty severe ADD and depression. i get really terrible ADD paralysis, meaning no matter how much i want or need to do something, i physically can’t move / get up to do it. I have nearly failed my course, which I only passed by working for a week straight, almost 15 hours most days. this completely shattered me. 

What i’m saying is that i find it almost impossible to do anything if i’m not under panic attack-inducing pressure. 

This changed when I started using this app again. i started on the standard version about a year ago which i loved so much that I decided to upgrade to premium. after applying for a discounted rate (due to my circumstances) i was able to pay significantly less which has also helped me hugely (THANK YOU SO MUCH!). I now feel motivated to get things done without having to fight the ‘just do it later’ voice in my head. i’ve got so much done without getting too stressed, and most importantly i’ve learnt the ways I work the most productively in. the app helps you to realistically plan your day with the ‘energy limit’ which helps you track how much energy each task gives or takes, and how much energy you have to spare each day. 

I have some suggestions that would make this app perfect! When a task takes longer than planned, i find myself having to individually adjust the rest of the tasks in the day. If i could move all incomplete tasks forward an hour at once, for example, this would save a huge amount of time. 

I love the AI feature, but I would like to be able to adjust the timings of each task before i add them to my day. 

The last thing - the energy limit feature would work so much better if i had more options (e.g. some tasks are more energy restoring than others, and would also like more than 3 ⚡️options). 

Thank you again to the developers behind this app!❤️

- On Mac there hasn't been enough effort tweaking it for Mac and desktop use.

- There is no ongoing habit tracking

- On Mac editng the time for a task is clunky. Vey negative experience.

- Fit and feel could be better

- App doesn't felly snappy, the whole thing felt cumersome.

Simple, visual, uncomplicated. I’ve been using it for years and it never fails to deliver. Absolutely worth buying the pro version.
Ok no joke this is the best planner aver I have tried others but so far this is in the lead I don’t know if it’s just me who had an amaizing experience but yeah definitely recommend by a thousand

Good interface and app but recurring tasks are locked behind a subscription. Sad because it seems to be a very basic feature in a planner. 

This type of app can easily be replicated and even self-made in Notion. Even apple calendar can replace it. £30 for lifetime is quite high too.
I would rather there be ad banners like myfitnesspal instead of you guys being forced to paywall basic stuff to make money.

I have a disability and although I’m unable to work, I keep myself busy with a big To Do list each day and I use apps to organise my tasks. Structured is by far the best I’ve come across. Due to being on disability payments and my low income, I requested a scholarship and was able to get a full year of the app for free which will help me a lot navigating my every day. Now I can sync my calendar to the app and everything blends together nicely. I’m very grateful for the scholarship, thank you. Recommend
Easy to navigate through app, cues are clear and pleasant to use on a daily basis.

I’ve tried so many different todo and other productivity apps, including even OmniFocus, supposedly the king of GTD (Getting Things Done). Yet I’ve never really felt content or even supported at all by an app like I do now by Structured.

I would love a few more little features:
- to make a task go into focus mode automatically at the start of the task
- subtask list to be fully editable without clicking the big Edit button first
- tick status of subtasks to be shared between the days for repeating tasks (I understand this would be a controversial feature and may not be appreciated by everyone)

I pay for a yearly premium. It is worth every penny. This is my second year using the app.
My brain can be so Squirrley and it’s just so helpful. As soon as I think of something I’ll write it in straight away then I just listen to the alerts or check throughout the day to make sure that I’m on track to achieve what I want to do.
It is also really good at making things realistic because we can all think of a 1000 things that we want to do in a day. What this app does is help you prioritise what’s important and how long it’s gonna take, so you can work out what is achievable whilst being less stressed out.
It is really good really recommend!
Would give 5 stars if it had a overview of weekly/monthly tasks

As a person with adhd I’m always missing commitments and getting into trouble at work because I am very forgetful. This app has changed all that! The notifications mean even if I have completely forgotten what I have to do that day, I will be reminded with plenty of time to get there on time. If you struggle with scheduling, time management and forgetting deadlines this is the app you’ve been waiting for xx
It would be a great help if Structured was able to insert pictures, photos, videos.

title.label: Pretty good but could be better

content.label: I would like a feature to be able to “snooze / postpone” a task to the next available time

Missing a few key features. 

Currently overlapping tasks are jarring. With a block booking of time eg work 9-5, you need to be able to add subtasks within the main task with their own time slots eg meeting 2-3 or other tasks altogether without it breaking the flow of the day.

Also an option for tasks to end when you mark them as complete as well as an option to move all subsequent tasks forwards if you do finish a task early. 

It’s a great app in principle but the functionality isn’t fantastic, spend too much time having to rearrange tasks.

Firstly I’d like to say the developer of this application is an absolute gem and really cares about the end user.

I remember struggling time management at university and came across this, it helped me so much to focus on the task at hand and organise my day. 

Thanks to the developer for providing me with free lifetime access after messaging him as whilst I was university I did not have any income.
This is the best app in this category

I really like this app, just so simple yet useful  Exactly what I needed! You can plan everyday in a clear and aesthetic way, AI planning is also helpful. I saw they also offer discounts if you’re struggling financially but would like to use this app to help with organising your life and getting better 🫶🏼

One of the most useful apps on my phone, I use it alongside the Apple calendar, Google keep & Routine Flow, sometimes notion for planning my days. I’ve tried most of the other apps out there and this ones stuck for me. 

I go through phases of using it. I love being able to customise the colours. The app helps with my understanding of time (my worst ADD symptom) & I’m so grateful for that. 

! Structured would be perfect if moving things around was easier - i really wish that I could drag things around to later than the last scheduled task without it overlapping / having to go into edit task & use the time spinner. 
Would also be great to be able to shift everything scheduled in a day to earlier or later as a group/at once ! 

:)

I love everything about this app. The way it works, that is connected with my calendars, but specially the design and the fact that you can choose colours and icons, which make it very visual. I started trying it with the free plan, and later updated to payment because I thought that it was the same price per year than a paper agenda and it really worth it.
Structured is BY FAR my favourite planner apps I’ve tried, like digital notebook apps, to-do list apps, etc. The layout and design is simple, but pretty and easy to use. Love this app! 🫶
